newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisian leasing firm ATL floats 200,000 new share.
newsitem.headline: Tunisian leasing firm ATL floats 200,000 new share.

text.p: Tunisian leasing company Arab Tunisian Lease (ATL) on Monday announced that it was issuing 200,000 new shares representing 10 percent of its capital as a first step before being listed on the Tunis Stock Exchange.
The firm, a subsidiary of Arab Tunisian Bank, said subscription priority to the new shares was reserved to the current shareholders and the reminder would be offered to the public on May 23.
The issue of the new shares at the nominal price of 10 dinars each would enable ATL to raise its capital from eight to 10 million dinars.
ATL earlier this month announced that it was also planning bond issues totalling 10 million dinars details of which will be decided later.
ATL's net profits for 1996 amounted to 1.81 million dinars It plans to distribute a five percent statutory dividend and a six percent super dividend for the 1996 results.
